description: Encodes plain UTF-8 text into rot13, base64, base64url, base32, hex, uuencode, urlcomponent (RFC 3986 percent-encoding, space -> %20), urlform (application/x-www-form-urlencoded, space -> +), or html (entity-escapes < > & ' "). Returns plain ASCII.

format.description: rot13, base64, base64url, base32, hex, uuencode, urlcomponent, urlform, or html

name: encode_encode
